dos.title: Buy an electronic motorway vignette (eznamka)
dos.description: Before driving on Slovak highways (Diaľnica), register your license plate on eznamka.sk to prevent heavy fines.

dos.title: Validate public transport tickets immediately
dos.description: Paper transit tickets must be validated inside the bus or tram stamping machine right upon boarding.

dos.title: Check mountain rescue insurance in High Tatras
dos.description: Mountain rescue operations (HZS) are not covered by state healthcare; obtain basic mountain sports insurance before hiking.

donts.title: Don't confuse Slovakia with Slovenia
donts.description: Locals are proud of Slovak heritage, language, and culture; confusing the two distinct Slavic nations can be seen as careless.

donts.title: Don't drive with any alcohol in your blood
donts.description: Slovakia enforces a strict zero-tolerance policy (0.00‰ BAC) for drinking and driving with severe criminal penalties.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% is customary in sit-down restaurants in Bratislava when service is not explicitly included in the total.
